lines.text: Many learners say: We arrived to the city late.
Better: We arrived in the city late.
In! We arrived in a small town.

data.wrong: We arrived to the city late.
data.right: We arrived in the city late.

native.tip: Kita bilang “sampai ke kota”, jadi sering pakai to. Bahasa Inggris pakai arrive in untuk kota.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “We arrived to the city late.” 😅 Untuk kota, pakai arrive in: “We arrived in the city late.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “in”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “We arrived in the city late.” Lalu ganti the city dengan kota yang pernah kamu kunjungi. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “sampai ke kota”, so we often use to. English uses arrive in for a city.
en.caption: Ever say this? “We arrived to the city late.” 😅 For a city, use arrive in: “We arrived in the city late.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
